title: What do your parents do?

before.predict: Look at the picture. What jobs do you think the parents have?

text.title: My mum and dad at work
paragraphs: My mother is a **doctor**. She **works** in a big **hospital** in our city. She starts very **early**, at seven o'clock in the morning. She helps children and she is very kind. Sometimes she comes home late, but she is never angry. Her favourite patients are the small children, because they are very brave.

My father is a taxi **driver**. He **works** in the afternoon and in the evening. He knows every street in our city! He tells us funny stories about his customers at dinner. On Sundays he does not work, and we all go to the park together.
My grandmother does not work now, but she was a teacher for thirty years. Many people in our street say, “Good morning, teacher!” to her. She still helps me with my reading every evening.
I am very **proud** of my family. And I want to be a **doctor**, like my mother.
